heading.title: Death, Marriage and Insolvency or Parties

article.title: No abatement by party’s death if right to sue survives.
article.content:
1No abatement by party’s death if right to sue survives.

Order 22, Rule 1
The death of a plaintiff or defendant shall not cause the suit to abate if the right to sue survives.
